children: Overview
China construction services provider's interim revenue surged yr/yr, but posted a loss for the period
Gross profit margin declined to 11.1% from 12.0% in prior year period
Loss driven by lower other income and increased recognition of financial liability
Outlook
Wenye Group expects six of 11 contracts worth RMB233.7 mln excluding VAT to complete in Q4 2026
Result Drivers
NEW PROJECT WINS - Co said 11 contracts worth RMB233.7 mln supported the core-business recovery, lifting revenue to RMB84.3 mln from RMB4.2 mln
DISPOSAL GAIN ABSENCE - The swing to a RMB4.2 mln loss from RMB885.8 mln profit reflected 1H2025's one-off gain on disposal of Wenye Decoration
OTHER INCOME DROP & FINANCIAL LIABILITY - Loss driven by lower other income and increased recognition of financial liability
